items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right. Poissy got in there.
I remember T-Boy Ramey was there when I first heard him. T-Boy, you remember? Yeah. And T-Boy? Yeah.

Willie Paggio. Used to play the trumpet? Well, yeah, them were the late ones. Those were late, late, late. I remember T-Boy too. If you took Wilson there died then, that's who...that's how Joe got in there when Wilson died. Oh, yeah. When Landry died after Wilson.
